en.t: Gradually the red sun sank toward the west.

units.source_text: 阳光照人，鲜艳如火；乐声鼎沸，舞兴正酣。

en.t: The sunlight shone upon the people, brilliant as fire; the music swelled, and the dance was at its height.

units.source_text: 此时两人共舞，步态与表情异常优美，世无其比。

en.t: At that moment the two danced together, their steps and expressions extraordinarily graceful, without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 源氏中将的歌咏[\[3\]](#part1336.html#m3)尤为动听，

en.t: Lieutenant General Genji's singing[\[3\]](#part1336.html#m3) was especially moving,

units.source_text: 简直像佛国里的仙鸟迦陵频伽[\[4\]](#part1336.html#m4)的鸣声。

en.t: just like the song of the celestial bird Kalavinka[\[4\]](#part1336.html#m4) in the Buddha land.

units.source_text: 美妙之极，皇上感动得流下泪来。

en.t: It was so wondrously beautiful that the Emperor was moved to tears.

units.source_text: 公卿和亲王等也都流泪。

en.t: The court nobles and princes also all shed tears.

units.source_text: 歌咏既毕，重整舞袖，另演新姿。

en.t: When the singing ended, they rearranged their dancing sleeves and performed in a new style.

units.source_text: 此时乐声大作，响彻云霄。

en.t: Then the music rose powerfully, resounding up to the clouds.

units.source_text: 源氏中将脸上的光彩比平常更加焕发了。

en.t: The radiance on Lieutenant General Genji's face shone even more brightly than usual.

units.source_text: 皇太子的母亲弘徽殿女御看了源氏公子这等美丽的姿态，心中愤愤不平，说道：

en.t: Kokiden no Nyogo, the Crown Prince's mother, saw Prince Genji's beautiful bearing and, feeling bitter resentment in her heart, said:

units.source_text: “定是鬼神看上他了，教人毛骨悚然呢！”

en.t: "Surely some demon or spirit has taken a liking to him. It makes one's hair stand on end!"

units.source_text: 众青年侍女听了这话，都嫌她冷酷无情。

en.t: When the young waiting women heard these words, they all thought her cold and heartless.
Lady Fujitsubo saw this and thought:

units.source_text: “此人心中若不负疚，一定更加可喜。”

en.t: "If this man did not carry guilt in his heart, he would surely be even more delightful."
She sank into thoughts of the past, as though entering a dream.
